## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive; confirmation 1) only four sectors are positive on the week and 2) leadership concentrated in a few tech names while Financials and Communication are broadly weak — plus multiple 1W/1M divergences suggest mixed internals.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Technology leading on a headline basis with PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +0.25%) and INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.45% | 1M: +12.52%); other Tech leaders include AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.24% | 1M: +12.53%). Healthcare also showing leadership with TMO ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.23% | 1M: +11.85%) and ISRG in RECOVERY (1W: +6.40% | 1M: -1.95%). Consumer Staples/Energy are modestly positive (e.g., VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.03% | 1M: +17.85%)).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Communication weak: CHTR BELOW TREND (1W: -5.12% | 1M: -10.10%), CMCSA BELOW TREND (1W: -8.98% | 1M: -12.56%), TMUS BELOW TREND (1W: -6.05% | 1M: -8.39%). Financials down: GS BELOW TREND (1W: -6.70% | 1M: -8.11%), BAC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.00% | 1M: -8.96%), JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.20% | 1M: -3.84%). Industrials also soft with BA BELOW TREND (1W: -3.81% | 1M: -11.68%) and CAT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -5.03%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +0.25%), TMO ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.23% | 1M: +11.85%), INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.45% | 1M: +12.52%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.24% | 1M: +12.53%), MPC ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.53% | 1M: +15.54%). Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: CHTR BELOW TREND (1W: -5.12% | 1M: -10.10%), CVS BELOW TREND (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -4.89%), TMUS BELOW TREND (1W: -6.05% | 1M: -8.39%), GS BELOW TREND (1W: -6.70% | 1M: -8.11%), BAC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.00% | 1M: -8.96%). Weakness concentrated in Communication and Financials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W movers: PANW (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +0.25%) and TMO (1W: +9.23% | 1M: +11.85%) with follow-through among several semis (INTC, AMD, QCOM). Note major divergence across several large names: NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +0.45% | 1M: -0.07%), ISRG RECOVERY (1W: +6.40% | 1M: -1.95%), LLY RECOVERY (1W: +2.62% | 1M: -5.98%) — treat as tactical noise until confirmed.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed but positive on the week (Technology 1W: +2.04%). AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.19% | 1M: +8.70%) and MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.08% | 1M: +3.54%) show resilience while semicap names AMAT BELOW TREND (1W: -8.06% | 1M: -18.76%) and LRCX BELOW TREND (1W: -9.63% | 1M: -17.87%) remain weak; NVDA in RECOVERY (1W: +0.45% | 1M: -0.07%) is a key watch.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials are lagging on the week (Financials 1W: -2.28%); GS BELOW TREND (1W: -6.70% | 1M: -8.11%), BAC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.00% | 1M: -8.96%) and JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.20% | 1M: -3.84%) show sector stress — breadth weak and no clear rotation into banks.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare mildly positive (Healthcare 1W: +1.91%) with TMO ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.23% | 1M: +11.85%) and JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.45% | 1M: +0.16%); ISRG in RECOVERY (1W: +6.40% | 1M: -1.95%) and CVS BELOW TREND (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -4.89%) highlight internal dispersion.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Neutral posture: favor selective exposure to confirmed ABOVE TREND leaders in Tech and Healthcare (e.g., PANW, TMO, INTC) and reduce exposure to lagging Financials and Communications (GS, BAC, CHTR). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given concentrated tech gains and broad Financials weakness; monitor the multi-name 1W/1M divergences before adding risk.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +0.25%), TMO ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.23% | 1M: +11.85%), INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.45% | 1M: +12.52%). BEARISH: CHTR BELOW TREND (1W: -5.12% | 1M: -10.10%), GS BELOW TREND (1W: -6.70% | 1M: -8.11%), BAC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.00% | 1M: -8.96%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Technology and Healthcare (both showing pockets of strength; watch semis for confirmation). BEARISH: Financials and Communication — continued flows or negative news could widen the leadership gap; Industrials also at risk.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +0.45% | 1M: -0.07%) for failure to regain a positive 1M (trend-break trigger); PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +0.25%) sustaining this week's momentum is a bullish continuation cue; GS/BAC breaches of recent weekly lows would confirm bank-led risk expansion; ISRG RECOVERY (1W: +6.40% | 1M: -1.95%) needs follow-through after EU approval to validate the move.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
ISRG (+80): ISRG RECOVERY (1W: +6.40% | 1M: -1.95%) — EU approval and price strength are confirming. TMO (+60): TMO ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.23% | 1M: +11.85%) — upbeat demand commentary confirms the rally. VLO (+55): VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.03% | 1M: +17.85%) — earnings/estimates-driven sentiment confirmed by price action. CHTR (+55): CHTR BELOW TREND (1W: -5.12% | 1M: -10.10%) — bullish headline but price is diverging (distribution risk).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
BA (-55): BA BELOW TREND (1W: -3.81% | 1M: -11.68%) — production/delivery headlines confirm downside pressure. BAC (-55): BAC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.00% | 1M: -8.96%) — bond-loss headlines align with weak price action. (Monitor related Financials headlines for broader flow risk.)

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership. PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +0.25%), TMO ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.23% | 1M: +11.85%) and INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.45% | 1M: +12.52%) are showing relative strength. Key risk: multi-name 1W/1M divergences (NVDA, ISRG, LLY) and weak Financials/Communication breadth — watch for confirmation before shifting stance.
